author: Ronald Murchison
text: I'm on Medicare also and never had a problem getting replacements. I pay $160.75 for a 3 month supply and customer service has always been good. Sounds like you took off the sensors because you weren't happy with the readings. You should never remove the sensors unless the app or reader tells you to. Find another site for your sensors. Try them on your belly, thigh, etc. If you do, and have to call one in, always tell them it was on the back of your arm.
